scope: Read-only snapshot of all files in test/script roots plus repository-wide source, script and build-definition candidates. File presence and hashes are not proof of safety or authorization.

discovery.case_handling: The provisional checker accepts ASCII source paths only and refuses case-fold collisions; non-ASCII paths require review.

enforcement_boundary: Inventory is data only. Direct execution of legacy scripts and runners is NOT governed or intercepted by this file. No source hash alone authenticates an executing binary. Governance integration, discovery enforcement and B/C human-authorization verification remain required.
authorization_boundary: Environment variables, flags, self-attestation and successful preflight are not authorization. A reviewer-approved human-supplied artifact can establish stated approval only after machine identity, scope, issuer, expiry and artifact authenticity are independently verified; no such verifier is implemented by this inventory.

profiles.A: Development-safe operations only after complete source, transitive build-hook and write-boundary audit.
profiles.B: Existing authorized disposable isolated Windows environment for hazardous lifecycle, junction, trust and browser acceptance.
profiles.C: Two existing authorized isolated machines, written network/WFP/audit scope, independent receiver and approved out-of-band evidence transfer.
